description:
jmap-metadata-types/src/backend.rs:58-61 declares:

    impl QueryObject for crate::Metadata {
        type Filter = crate::MetadataFilterCondition;
        type Comparator = serde_json::Value;
    }

Filter is typed (good); Comparator is serde_json::Value (problem). Per workspace AGENTS.md "Filter algebra and control enums are explicitly EXCLUDED" from the extras-preservation pattern — but that exclusion is about adding extra fields, not about replacing the type with serde_json::Value altogether.

The spec § 3.4.2 enumerates a closed set of MUST-/SHOULD-support sort keys:
  *  id (MUST)
  *  @type, relatedType, relatedId, isPrivate (SHOULD)

Backends need to dispatch on the comparator value to implement sort. With Comparator = serde_json::Value, every backend has to do its own ad-hoc parsing of the JSON shape to recover "which sort key was requested". This:

1. Pushes parsing duplication into every implementor.
2. Allows wire-level acceptance of nonsense (e.g. {"property": 42, "isAscending": "yes"}) — the JmapHandler accepts whatever serde_json::Value the wire produces; the backend has to validate.
3. Makes the workspace's own MemoryBackend impl at memory.rs:484-532 ignore the comparator entirely (params are _filter, _sort).

Compare canonical jmap-mail-server which has typed comparators (EmailComparator, MailboxComparator, etc.) so the wire shape is validated at deserialize time.

Fix: define MetadataComparator as a typed struct with field: MetadataSortKey, is_ascending: bool, where MetadataSortKey is an enum over {Id, TypeName, RelatedType, RelatedId, IsPrivate}, with #[non_exhaustive] and ideally Unknown(String) per the workspace result-enum policy IF the workspace's filter-algebra exclusion is read as not applying to comparators (which the AGENTS.md does seem to say: it lists EmailComparator etc. as IN scope of the exclusion). The cleaner read is: comparators are control enums on a closed spec list, and Unknown(String) is wrong because the backend can't sort on an unknown key. So keep the comparator strictly typed without Unknown(String).

This is partially a metadata-types finding (the type alias is wrong) and partially a metadata-server one (the handler shim must validate). The Comparator change is a public-API break, but the crate is pre-1.0 so it can land before publish. Bundle into a metadata-types child bead AND a metadata-server child bead. Block on the metadata-types fix.

Related: JMAP-ayoz.6 will surface this when /query tests actually exercise sort.

Severity: P1 because once this ships with serde_json::Value Comparator, downstream backends will encode their own validation idioms and the public-API change becomes harder. Pre-1.0 fix is cheap; post-1.0 is breaking.
title: Metadata/query/queryChanges Comparator is serde_json::Value — control surface escape
